plan.notes: Source: Central Piedmont Community College 2026-2027 Catalog (official, catalog.cpcc.edu), Information Technology - Software Engineering (A25590SE), 'Suggested Course Sequence' / Plan of Study Grid. Semester sums verified against catalog-published totals; grand total 71 verified. Choice slots: 'or' alternates and unnamed elective slots transcribed as choice placeholders, documented per slot. Course prerequisites are not stated in the sequence grid and are not recorded.
